    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Cilium Native eBPF Host-Routing 模式使用说明</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h1 id="模式介绍">模式介绍</h1>
<blockquote>
<p>项目文档：<a href="https://docs.cilium.io/en/stable/operations/performance/tuning/#ebpf-host-routing" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://docs.cilium.io/en/stable/operations/performance/tuning/#ebpf-host-routing</a></p>
</blockquote>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3735354/202605/3735354-20260502175856826-950888213.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3735354/202605/3735354-20260502180051887-621187437.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3735354/202605/3735354-20260502180111172-1128888665.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>标准容器网络模式下，流量从 Pod 发出后，经过 Pod 网络空间的 iptables 规则处理，通过 veth pair 到达宿主机网络空间，再由宿主机 iptables 完成路由转发与地址转换，最终从宿主机网卡发出；</p>
<p>而 Cilium Native eBPF Host Routing 模式下，通过引入 <strong><a href="https://docs.ebpf.io/linux/helper-function/bpf_redirect_peer/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">bpf_redirect_peer()</a></strong> 与 <strong><a href="https://docs.ebpf.io/linux/helper-function/bpf_redirect_neigh/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">bpf_redirect_neigh()</a></strong> 函数，实现数据包从物理网卡的 TC ingress 直接重定向到 Pod veth 的 TC ingress，跳过宿主机 veth pair 设备驱动的收包处理，从而显著提升网络性能。参考文章：</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://isovalent.com/blog/post/cilium-netkit-a-new-container-networking-paradigm-for-the-ai-era/#shortcut-2-ebpf-based-host-routing" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">基于 eBPF 的主机路由</a></li>
<li><a href="https://cilium.io/blog/2020/11/10/cilium-19/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">利用 eBPF 实现虚拟以太网设备优化</a></li>
<li><a href="https://arthurchiao.art/blog/differentiate-bpf-redirects/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">区分三种类型的 eBPF 重定向</a></li>
</ul>
<h1 id="部署流程">部署流程</h1>
<h2 id="使用-cilium-代替-kube-proxy">使用 Cilium 代替 Kube-Proxy</h2>
<p>部署 k8s 集群时<a href="https://docs.cilium.io/en/stable/network/kubernetes/kubeproxy-free/#quick-start" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">跳过 kube-proxy 安装</a>，<a href="https://docs.cilium.io/en/stable/network/kubernetes/kubeproxy-free" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">通过 Cilium 代替 kube-proxy</a>。</p>
<p>Cilium 通过挂载 <a href="https://docs.cilium.io/en/stable/network/kubernetes/kubeproxy-free/#validate-bpf-cgroup-programs-attachment" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">BPF cgroup</a> 程序来实现基于 Socket 的负载均衡（即 host-reachable 服务）。Socket LB 依赖的 BPF cgroup 挂载（connect4、sendmsg4 等）是 cgroup v2 的特性。cgroup v1 不支持这些挂载类型，所以<strong>使用 kube-proxy replacement 必须开启 cgroup v2</strong>。</p>
<h2 id="通过-kind-快速生成集群并部署-cilium-native-模式">通过 Kind 快速生成集群并部署 Cilium Native 模式</h2>
<blockquote>
<p>使用 cilium native 模式，并且通过 <code>kubeProxyReplacement=true</code> 代替 kube-proxy</p>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-bash">#!/bin/bash
set -v

# 1. Prepare NoCNI kubernetes environment
cat &lt;&lt;EOF | HTTP_PROXY= HTTPS_PROXY= http_proxy= https_proxy= kind create cluster --name=cilium-kpr-ebpf --image=kindest/node:v1.27.3 --config=-
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
networking:
  ## 关闭集群默认 CNI 部署
  disableDefaultCNI: true
  ## 关闭集群 kubeproxy 部署
  kubeProxyMode: "none"
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF

# 2. Remove kubernetes node taints
controller_node_ip=`kubectl get node -o wide --no-headers | grep -E "control-plane|bpf1" | awk -F " " '{print $6}'`
kubectl taint nodes $(kubectl get nodes -o name | grep control-plane) node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane:NoSchedule-

# 3. Install CNI[Cilium v1.17.15]
cilium_version=v1.17.15
docker pull cilium/cilium:$cilium_version &amp;&amp; docker pull cilium/operator-generic:$cilium_version
kind load docker-image cilium/cilium:$cilium_version cilium/operator-generic:$cilium_version --name cilium-kpr-ebpf

helm repo add cilium https://helm.cilium.io ; helm repo update
helm install cilium cilium/cilium --set k8sServiceHost=$controller_node_ip --set k8sServicePort=6443 --version 1.17.15 --namespace kube-system --set image.pullPolicy=IfNotPresent --set debug.enabled=true --set debug.verbose="datapath flow kvstore envoy policy" --set bpf.monitorAggregation=none --set monitor.enabled=true --set ipam.mode=cluster-pool --set cluster.name=cilium-kpr-ebpf --set kubeProxyReplacement=true --set routingMode=native --set autoDirectNodeRoutes=true --set ipv4NativeRoutingCIDR="10.0.0.0/8" --set bpf.masquerade=true

# 6. Separate namesapce and cgroup v2 verify [https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/16259 &amp;&amp; https://docs.cilium.io/en/stable/installation/kind/#install-cilium]
#for container in $(docker ps -a --format "table {{.Names}}" | grep cilium-kpr-ebpf);do docker exec $container ls -al /proc/self/ns/cgroup;done
#mount -l | grep cgroup &amp;&amp; docker info | grep "Cgroup Version" | awk '$1=$1'
</code></pre>
<h2 id="创建测试-pod">创建测试 Pod</h2>
<blockquote>
<p>本质是 Nginx，仅用于通过访问 svc 时抓包使用</p>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-yaml">apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  labels:
    app: nginx
  name: pod
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: nginx
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: nginx
    spec:
      containers:
      - image: burlyluo/nettool:latest
        name: nettoolbox
        env:
          - name: NETTOOL_NODE_NAME
            valueFrom:
              fieldRef:
                fieldPath: spec.nodeName
        securityContext:
          privileged: true
      affinity:
        podAntiAffinity:
          requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
          - labelSelector:
              matchLabels:
                app: nginx
            topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname

---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: pod
spec:
  type: NodePort
  selector:
    app: nginx
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 80
    targetPort: 80
    nodePort: 32000
</code></pre>

<h3 id="2查询-cilium-endpoint-信息">2.查询 Cilium Endpoint 信息</h3>
<blockquote>
<p>在 Cilium 中，<a href="https://docs.cilium.io/en/stable/gettingstarted/terminology/#endpoints" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">Endpoint 术语含义</a>：Cilium 为容器分配 IP。一个 Pod 中可以包含多个容器（多个容器共享同一个 Pod IP）。所有共享同一地址的容器被分组在一起，Cilium 将其称为一个 Endpoint。</p>
<p><strong>每个节点的 Cilium Agent 只管理本节点的 Endpoint</strong>，所以不同节点的 cilium endpoint list 输出不同，本次以 Controller 节点 Pod 作为示例：</p>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-bash">root@network-demo:~# kubectl exec -n kube-system cilium-7jjcl -- cilium endpoint list
ENDPOINT   POLICY (ingress)   POLICY (egress)   IDENTITY   LABELS (source:key[=value])                                     IPv4         STATUS   
           ENFORCEMENT        ENFORCEMENT                                                                                                               
10         Disabled           Disabled          25489      k8s:app=nginx                                                   10.0.2.19    ready
                                                           k8s:io.cilium.k8s.namespace.labels/metadata.name=default
                                                           k8s:io.cilium.k8s.policy.cluster=cilium-kpr-ebpf
                                                           k8s:io.cilium.k8s.policy.serviceaccount=default
                                                           k8s:io.kubernetes.pod.namespace=default
786        Disabled           Disabled          1          k8s:node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane                                    ready
                                                           k8s:node.kubernetes.io/exclude-from-external-load-balancers
                                                           reserved:host
2559       Disabled           Disabled          4          reserved:health                                                 10.0.2.110   ready
</code></pre>
<h3 id="3查询-cilium-service-信息">3.查询 Cilium Service 信息</h3>
<blockquote>
<p>在 Cilium 中，<a href="https://docs.cilium.io/en/stable/network/kubernetes/intro/#service-load-balancing" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">Service 术语含义</a>：k8s svc 在 Cilium eBPF Map 中实际转发状态（Cilium 代替了 k8s kube-proxy）</p>
<p>Cilium 用 eBPF map 替代 iptables 实现的 k8s svc 负载均衡表：</p>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-bash">root@network-demo:~# kubectl exec -n kube-system cilium-7jjcl -- cilium service list

<h2 id="查询-iptables-规则">查询 iptables 规则</h2>
<h3 id="1查询使用-kube-proxy-集群的-iptables-规则">1.查询使用 kube-proxy 集群的 iptables 规则</h3>
<p>这里的查询环境使用 Calico VXLan 模式的 k8s 集群</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">## 只看 NodePort 3112 部分
root@calico-vxlan:~# kubectl get svc -n deepflow-otel-spring-demo web-shop
NAME       TYPE       CLUSTER-IP       EXTERNAL-IP   PORT(S)          AGE
web-shop   NodePort   172.96.248.195   &lt;none&gt;        18090:3112/TCP   176d
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-bash">## 在 iptables 规则中查询 Service NodePort 3112 相关内容
root@ce-demo-1:~# iptables-save | grep 3112 -w

## 规则一：
## 额外匹配了目标地址是 localhost 的流量，例如 curl 127.0.0.1:3112
## nfacct 是内核模块提供的网络包计数器。这里只是挂的 localhost_nps_accepted_pkts 的计数器仅用于统计
## 区分流量来源，方便做监控
-A KUBE-NODEPORTS -d 127.0.0.0/8 -p tcp -m comment --comment "deepflow-otel-spring-demo/web-shop:http-shop" -m tcp --dport 3112 -m nfacct --nfacct-name  localhost_nps_accepted_pkts -j KUBE-EXT-YBYZULGZYV76JYRW

## 规则二：
## 外部流量访问 NodeIP:3112 时，在 PREROUTING 阶段会被引流到 KUBE-NODEPORTS
## 所有目标端口为 3112 的 TCP 包，统一跳转到 KUBE-EXT-YBYZULGZYV76JYRW 链
-A KUBE-NODEPORTS -p tcp -m comment --comment "deepflow-otel-spring-demo/web-shop:http-shop" -m tcp --dport 3112 -j KUBE-EXT-YBYZULGZYV76JYRW
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2查询-cilium-集群的-iptables-规则">2.查询 Cilium 集群的 iptables 规则</h3>
<p>由于部署集群时使用 Cilium 代替了 kube-proxy，所以不会有 iptables 规则（<strong>k8s svc 本质上是 iptables 规则</strong>）</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">root@network-demo:~# kubectl get svc pod 
NAME   TYPE       CLUSTER-IP      EXTERNAL-IP   PORT(S)        AGE
pod    NodePort   10.96.160.230   &lt;none&gt;        80:32000/TCP   25h
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-bash">## 可以看到 iptables 规则中没有 NodePort 相关的处理
root@network-demo:~# iptables-save | grep 32000
</code></pre>
<h2 id="pod-网卡处抓包">Pod 网卡处抓包</h2>
<pre><code class="language-bash">root@network-demo:~# kubectl get pods -o wide
NAME    READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE   IP           NODE
pod-0   1/1     Running   0          16m   10.0.1.231   cilium-kpr-ebpf-worker2
pod-1   1/1     Running   0          16m   10.0.0.153   cilium-kpr-ebpf-worker
pod-2   1/1     Running   0          16m   10.0.2.19    cilium-kpr-ebpf-control-plane
</code></pre>
<h3 id="1查询-pod-网卡与对应-veth-pair-信息">1.查询 Pod 网卡与对应 veth pair 信息</h3>
<blockquote>
<p>Pod 网卡信息中 @ifx 接口编号与宿主机侧网卡编号对应即可</p>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-bash">root@network-demo:~# kubectl exec pod-2 -- ip address show eth0
8: eth0@if9: &lt;BROADCAST,MULTICAST,UP,LOWER_UP&gt; mtu 1500 qdisc noqueue state UP group default qlen 1000
    link/ether ca:e8:ab:e0:8e:c1 brd ff:ff:ff:ff:ff:ff link-netnsid 0
    inet 10.0.2.19/32 scope global eth0
       valid_lft forever preferred_lft forever


root@network-demo:~# docker exec cilium-kpr-ebpf-control-plane ip address show lxc939e7d20131a
9: lxc939e7d20131a@if8: &lt;BROADCAST,MULTICAST,UP,LOWER_UP&gt; mtu 1500 qdisc noqueue state UP group default qlen 1000
    link/ether 9a:6c:ff:92:85:f5 brd ff:ff:ff:ff:ff:ff link-netns cni-e8d9d993-3bd7-9552-06e8-92f205293390
    inet6 fe80::986c:ffff:fe92:85f5/64 scope link 
       valid_lft forever preferred_lft forever


root@network-demo:~# docker exec cilium-kpr-ebpf-control-plane ip -d link show lxc939e7d20131a
9: lxc939e7d20131a@if8: &lt;BROADCAST,MULTICAST,UP,LOWER_UP&gt; mtu 1500 qdisc noqueue state UP mode DEFAULT group default qlen 1000
    link/ether 9a:6c:ff:92:85:f5 brd ff:ff:ff:ff:ff:ff link-netns cni-e8d9d993-3bd7-9552-06e8-92f205293390 promiscuity 0 minmtu 68 maxmtu 65535 
    veth addrgenmode eui64 numtxqueues 8 numrxqueues 8 gso_max_size 65536 gso_max_segs 65535
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2client-pod-eth0-侧抓包">2.Client Pod eth0 侧抓包</h3>
<p>此时三次握手、四次挥手，流量走向是正常的</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3735354/202605/3735354-20260502180149374-557715009.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">root@network-demo:~# kubectl exec -it pod-2 -- tcpdump -pnei eth0

<h3 id="3client-pod-宿主机-veth-pair-侧抓包">3.Client Pod 宿主机 veth pair 侧抓包</h3>
<p>此时只有请求流量，而响应流量已经被 <strong><a href="https://docs.ebpf.io/linux/helper-function/bpf_redirect_peer/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">bpf_redirect_peer()</a></strong> 函数重定向到 Pod eth0 处，跳过了宿主机侧的 veth pair</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3735354/202605/3735354-20260502180207544-1491062285.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
